title: Planning a weekend in the city
instructions: İki arkadaş şehirde geçirecekleri hafta sonunu planlıyor. Etkinlikler, günler ve maliyetleri takip et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: So, when you visit me next weekend, what would you like to do?

script.speaker: b
script.text: I'd love to see the old town and the castle.

script.speaker: a
script.text: The castle is open on Saturday until five. Tickets are twelve pounds.

script.speaker: a
script.text: There's a jazz concert in the park. It's free!

script.speaker: a
script.text: There's a big market by the river every Sunday morning. We could have breakfast there.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Lovely. My train home is at four, so that's perfect.
